(III) Average Annual financial turnover of the bidder/OEM of the relat ed services during the last (03) three years, ending 31st March o f the previous financial assessment year. (b) Non-availability of galley (c) Non-availability of A/C and ventilation. (d) If more than 50 % of living spaces are disturbed due to deguttin g – re – gutting.
